steps.name: Witch's Trace (1)
steps.objective: After talking with Theodore in “Guild City Esnil”, go to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Now I just have to finish it... , it's not easy.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Uncle, don’t push yourself too hard. Last time, my mother asked me to say thank you.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: No. I am more grateful. Please tell Sister I am grateful for letting me teach the children.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes! Uncle Theo is always welcome. Ah, %s. When did you come?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just now. hello. Theo, Narsha.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I have some work to do, so I’ll go first. Please share.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Okay, I got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narsha, goodbye.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: %s, seeing that you came to Esnil, it seems like things in Jisk's territory have ended well. thank god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, to some extent. But I don't know how much I should say.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's okay. Sir Giscard decided to send me a separate letter, so you don't have to worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I don't know what it is yet, but I know it's definitely a big deal. There is one thing that worries me about that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? that is… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You know that the Empire is paying attention to you, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I happen to be doing something related to it.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You're probably doing well without me having to say this, but please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I have a question: I heard that you have ties to a mysterious minority. Have you ever seen someone with a similar appearance to Narsha?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know that?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Narsha asked me something she was curious about while talking to you some time ago. It will also be that child's eternal task... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: However, since I don't know anything, I can't give you an easy answer. I want you to talk to Narsha about this and that later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anything like that is fine.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Where do we go now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have nowhere to go right now. When I see you say that... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Yeah. Princess Shiina at the Magic Academy... . No, Shiina was looking for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You don’t have to hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Still, wouldn't it be fun to do it this way with people you know? Dana, you revealed your identity really clumsily.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, after the Moros affair is over... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: How fun it was to hear that story. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Theo, aren't you going to be arrested for insulting the imperial family?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Haha, you shouldn't do that. Hurry and go to the magic academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Theo. See you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But why did Shiina look for me? I wonder….)

steps.name: Witch's Trace (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Beskar] in “Gem Tree Forest” and obtain <Tears of Light>. Then report to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Adventurer!
(As soon as Shiina sees %s, she approaches and hugs her.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I missed you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while. I was surprised when he suddenly came running towards me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Ah… .
(Shiina steps back as if embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. Without even realizing it, hugging has become a habit these days.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I already went to see my little sister, and I just told Teacher Theo that I wanted to see Adventurer... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything else besides that?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: There was a message from my eldest sister. I'd like to say, sister, do it yourself, but... . That doesn't work. Because you can't break the command. lol… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: What I'm going to tell you is a story about witches.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer would know this from what you said, right? I won't ask you how you know.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: What a night it was. A few days before my father passed away. A woman took me to them.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That woman was Daphne. They said they needed me and tried to take me to a dark place, but Kaina and Dana stopped me.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Members of the Order of the Moon's Wounds also helped.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It seemed like Kaina knew Daphne... . Anyway, Daphne introduced herself as a witch and asked me to forget about her, saying she would find another way.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The moment we heard those words, both the knights and our sisters lost their minds. When I woke up again, I couldn't remember Daphne like everyone had promised. but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: For some reason, it seems like Her Majesty and the sisters remember it.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Rarely is a child born into the royal family with special abilities... . At my university, all my sisters... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Big sister, little sister, and me... . A little bit like that.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: … My sister told me to pretend I lost my memory for the time being. Adventurer I think I said it because I was momentarily embarrassed when I asked Daphne... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Phew… , it was a bit long, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So, there is something you need to do. We need to awaken the memory of one person related to Daphne. That's my sister's message.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If there is only one person…, it is Medea….)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I think you remember something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . I have to go right away. I also know how... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I really appreciate it. It must not have been easy to talk like that.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's okay because I like Adventurer. and… I hope his memory of knowing a witch isn't a big deal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go then, Shiina... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (First, let’s look for the Tears of Light in the Jewel Tree Forest. Will we be able to find it?...)

steps.name: Witch's Trace (3)
steps.objective: Defeat [Requiem] at “God’s Tree Lapier” and obtain <Seed of Illusion>. Then report to [Medea] in “Kali”.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You've been through a lot in a short period of time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think you also know that I visited Jisk’s territory….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, there was some work going on.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Even if you don't want to know, it seems inevitable that you will find out.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please give me what you brought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew it. Now, here… . They are tears of light. Now, wait a minute. If you swallow this right away... .
(Medea swallows the tears of light she received.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Shinik is really nasty. Forcing this on you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, are you okay? media?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine. It doesn't taste good.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think there was something big Daphne wanted to hide from me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That's right. This doesn't work.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Humans are creatures that live with memories... . Based on those memories, we either maintain or give up on life.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you keep it, that memory will leave you with a good feeling. Although it will change to your advantage.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In that way, Daphne leaves me with a good feeling. However, the person who sent Adventurer here must feel differently than I do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Maybe so.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, please save me one more thing. There isn't much that comes to mind yet... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is what you got a long time ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seeds of illusion, right? Then I will find it quickly and come back.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, here is the seed of illusion.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you every time.
(Medea receives the Seed of Illusion and looks at it intently.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s. While I make the potion, could you please call Beynon for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beynon? Are you in town now?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I must have come back because I saw Merrymel there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Lately, he has been secretly taking Merrymel out of Adrika. It seems like he's trying to help me meet Noel near Tartarus... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't scold me too much. Because Beynon can protect Merrymel.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Who protects whom is never easy. If you can't bear that weight... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Sorry. You said something pointless. Anyway, Merrymel needs to become stronger too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is there something there?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, I will bring Beynon right away.
(Medea does not make medicine from the Seed of Illusion, but swallows it right away.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: (Daphne, what are you….)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Huh… … .
(Someone’s familiar voice is heard in Mediah’s ears.)
Medea.
Medea. media.
Medea. media. media.
Medea. media. media. media.
Medea. media. media. media. media.
Medea. media. media. media. media. media.
Medea. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media. media!!!
You shouldn't have brought up this memory!!
Do you think that the power you have was achieved solely through the sacrifice of your clan?!
(An afterimage of an incident continues to appear in Mediah's mind and then shatters like shards of glass.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, what the hell… . Uh, uh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to your senses, Medea!

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea! Medea!
(Medea, who fell down, stands up with Beynon's support.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: A persistent and harsh voice, ominous... . Why are you telling me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Oh, no. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, Seed of Illusion… . Did you swallow that all at once?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Well, I'm fine. Now I… . Oh, no. %s, please go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please go back!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea?

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: %s, I'm sorry, but as Mediah said, you must return today.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel the life in Baynon... If you don't go back, he looks like he's going to attack you right now...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please. Please come back today. I, I... . I'll call you separately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then take a break. I will come when you call me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is going on...?)
(Medea, seeing that %s has disappeared from Kali, holds Beynon and sobs.)

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea? Why... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Memories of that time... . Beynon will stay, right? must remain.

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That memory right before you died... .

lines.speaker: 베이넌
lines.text: Medea, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: What the hell!! What happened then? at that time… .
